scope: Constructive independent robustness pass on six expedition reports and selected primary sources. No new observations, postings, repository edits, or nonlinear collapse solution.

primary_sources.title: The Incomplete Rosetta Stone Problem: Identifiability Results for Multi-View Nonlinear ICA
primary_sources.inspected: Sections 3.1-3.3, Theorems 1 and 5, definition of sufficiently distinct views
primary_sources.support: Suitable multiview data can identify components up to declared ambiguities. Theorem 5 recovers corrupted components rather than exact noiseless samples.
primary_sources.limits: Smooth invertible mixing, independent components and noise, componentwise corruption, diversity, infinite-data/expressivity assumptions. The new known-linear probe does not implement this theorem.

primary_sources.title: Rosetta Stone supplement
primary_sources.inspected: Appendices A-C and Gaussian diversity discussion
primary_sources.support: General nonlinear ICA has ambiguities; specified diversity condition can fail for conditional Gaussian forms.
primary_sources.limits: No general inference that all Gaussian inference is unidentifiable. Known observation maps are a different problem.

primary_sources.title: Parameter Space Compression Underlies Emergent Theories and Predictive Models
primary_sources.inspected: Main text, Fisher metric equation 1, diffusion and Ising setup
primary_sources.support: In specified diffusion and Ising examples, coarse observations lose sensitivity to many microscopic combinations while preserving predictive effective parameters.
primary_sources.limits: A demonstrated connection in these models, not a universal theorem for every apparent convergence. Raw matrix eigenvalues depend on coordinates; distinguishability quadratic form has the invariant meaning.

primary_sources.title: Model Reduction by Manifold Boundaries
primary_sources.inspected: Primary author manuscript, abstract and main text through Fisher-metric construction
primary_sources.support: Model reduction can be formulated through output distributions and manifold boundaries for a fixed set of predictions.
primary_sources.limits: Full later re-open encountered recaptcha. Used only the successfully read primary text. No theorem that all models have an exploitable boundary hierarchy; no proof of a unique microscopic mechanism.

primary_sources.title: Relevance in the Renormalization Group and in Information Theory
primary_sources.inspected: Main equations 1-6, large-buffer construction, Appendix B, symmetry limitations in Appendix D
primary_sources.support: Information bottleneck relevance connects to leading transfer-matrix modes and low-scaling-dimension operators in a controlled short-range statistical model setting.
primary_sources.limits: Specified relevance variable, large buffer, strong-compression expansion and CFT interpretation matter. Arbitrary compression is not RG, and limited compressed capacity can break symmetries.

primary_sources.title: Quantum Darwinism in an Everyday Environment: Huge Redundancy in Scattered Photons
primary_sources.inspected: Figure 2 and equations 14-18, isotropic versus point-source discussion
primary_sources.support: Perfectly isotropic mixed directional illumination decoheres without redundant accessible records; nonuniform illumination can produce substantial redundancy.
primary_sources.limits: Ideal limiting counterexample, not a claim about generic sunlight or all scattering environments.

primary_sources.title: Objectivity (or lack thereof): Comparison between predictions of quantum Darwinism and spectrum broadcast structure
primary_sources.inspected: Abstract, Sections I and III.3, accessible-information distinction
primary_sources.support: Total mutual information and operationally accessible classical information need separate assessment.
primary_sources.limits: Specific finite environment and partition constructions. New Bell example independently verifies only the claim about records of the specified Z observable.

primary_sources.title: Topological Boundary Modes in Isostatic Lattices
primary_sources.inspected: Equations 1-2, definitions of compatibility/equilibrium matrices and D
primary_sources.support: Central-force spectra depend on bond-direction compatibility matrices. Maxwell-Calladine count follows rank-nullity.
primary_sources.limits: Does not prove topological protection or physical stability of the cab-to-fcc network. New probe is fixed-cell k=0, not full band structure.

primary_sources.title: Cooling, dynamics and fragmentation of massive gas clouds: clues to the masses and radii of galaxies and clusters
primary_sources.inspected: Primary publisher abstract and ADS primary scan passages
primary_sources.support: Cooling and gravitational collapse clocks distinguish evolutionary regimes and characteristic galaxy scales.
primary_sources.limits: Does not independently establish the repository selected Delta=1000, Hubble-time 178 km/s coincidence or a universal galaxy speed.

primary_sources.title: Boyle’s Law and Gravitational Instability
primary_sources.inspected: Summary and Section 3 stability analysis, pages 356-357
primary_sources.support: Isothermal self-gravitating pressure-confined stability needs a boundary-value problem and perturbations.
primary_sources.limits: Comparison only. Its threshold is not imposed on AeST or a tracer in an external potential. The new gamma=2 criticism follows directly from the repository formulas.

primary_sources.title: Aether scalar tensor theory: Hamiltonian Formalism
primary_sources.inspected: Section II equations 1-4, background definitions, abstract/conclusions six-degree-of-freedom statement
primary_sources.support: Supplies exact scalar action terms whose variation gives the checked shift current.
primary_sources.limits: Finite-difference test checks differentiation only. No energy trapping, entropy law, viable chosen polynomial or nonlinear collapse result follows. Additional higher derivatives alter the analysis.

primary_sources.title: New Relativistic Theory for Modified Newtonian Dynamics
primary_sources.inspected: Cosmological observables, equations 7-12 and explicit paragraph after equation 11
primary_sources.support: Effective pressure depends on vector perturbations and does not close in displayed fluid variables. A restricted dustlike limit can occur.
primary_sources.limits: Not an action-specific nonlinear post-caustic fluid closure, transport law, or proof of Dark-WHIM.

primary_sources.title: ASASSN-24fw: Candidate gas-rich circumsecondary disk occultation of a main-sequence star
primary_sources.inspected: Section III.1, historic and modern light curve and half-period discussion
primary_sources.support: DASCH admits a half-period alternative that ASAS normal-brightness measurements at the discriminating phase exclude.
primary_sources.limits: Published example, not an expedition discovery. Physical nature of the occulter remains model interpretation; repository candidate claims not independently verified here.

primary_sources.title: The Rise and Fall of the Eclipsing Binary HS Hydrae
primary_sources.inspected: Primary abstract; route report provides full-paper handoff
primary_sources.support: Long-baseline data trace fading eclipses and later TESS confirms cessation, associated with evolving inclination in a triple.
primary_sources.limits: Abstract-level independent check here. Source binary persists while eclipse visibility changes. No reanalysis of photometry by this route.

derived_claims.claim: Observation equivalence classes can grow under information loss and shrink under complementary known measurements.
derived_claims.independent_check: Explicit ranks, a shared-gain scaling ambiguity, parameter-transform invariant distinguishability and correlated-noise information saturation.
derived_claims.limits: Known linear maps or local Jacobian; not a general nonlinear identification theorem.

derived_claims.claim: Same complete dephasing channel and one-fragment mutual information can coexist with different local information about system Z.
derived_claims.independent_check: All four system matrix units, exact branch marginals, Holevo information and trace distance.
derived_claims.limits: Engineered finite system. Another system basis has readable records in Bell case.

derived_claims.claim: Fixed-bar central-spring fold has tr(D)=30 and tr(D^2)=96-12t^2 at fixed cell and Bloch k=0.
derived_claims.independent_check: Bond-direction construction, analytical trace identity, null-mode rank argument and direct finite-displacement energy Hessian.
derived_claims.limits: No new fcc springs, no prestress, no real CaB6 claim, no all-wavevector stability.

derived_claims.claim: gamma_d=2 is not a derived onset in the notebook hydrostatic expression.
derived_claims.independent_check: Independent mass integral x^(3-gamma) is smooth at gamma=2; separate f_trap ansatz juxtaposed.
derived_claims.limits: Does not exclude a threshold from fuller dynamics. No nonlinear AeST stability solved.

derived_claims.claim: Free-free cooling speed under fixed critical overdensity and Hubble clock scales as Delta H and diverges in redshift from repository sigma_star.
derived_claims.independent_check: Dimensional formula and clock/density scaling rederived.
derived_claims.limits: Collapse trajectory read from repository artifact, not independently recomputed. Ionized free-free regime and fixed composition assumed.

derived_claims.claim: Persistence route shift current follows from AeST scalar action.
derived_claims.independent_check: Independent variation and finite differences at 16 configurations.
derived_claims.limits: No implication of entropy conservation, energy retention or fluid closure.

derived_claims.claim: A specified nonlinear AeST closure might generate a persistent dispersion and actual trapping threshold.
derived_claims.independent_check: None; required mode, flux, stability and boundary checks proposed.
derived_claims.limits: The current expedition does not establish Dark-WHIM or a shared fundamental scale.

publication_note: Historical research snapshot prepared on 2026-11-12. Repository claims refer to the recorded studied revisions, not current main. Original research used gpt-6-astra with requested ultra reasoning; publication preparation used gpt-6.1-sol.
